title: The resident writes a project's telemetry to the data directory of the first hook that opened it
trigger: when DD telemetry looks empty or a hook's effect is missing from the store, or when measuring retrieval events, cap_saturation or activation counts
behavior_delta: Check which data directory the shared resident opened the project with before concluding the hooks never ran. Hooks post session-start, prompt and pre-tool to the machine's resident (callRunningStore), which keys projects by repo root and opens each with the data_dir of the first hook that asked (hookProject in src/ui/server.js). Later calls from a harness with a different data directory, such as Codex's <project>/.dd/local beside Claude Code's plugin data directory, write to that first directory until the resident exits. Compare the index.sqlite of each candidate data directory (modification time, memory_retrieval_events count) instead of trusting one.
what: Check which data directory the shared resident opened the project with before concluding the hooks never ran. Hooks post session-start, prompt and pre-tool to the machine's resident (callRunningStore), which keys projects by repo root and opens each with the data_dir of the first hook that asked (hookProject in src/ui/server.js). Later calls from a harness with a different data directory, such as Codex's <project>/.dd/local beside Claude Code's plugin data directory, write to that first directory until the resident exits. Compare the index.sqlite of each candidate data directory (modification time, memory_retrieval_events count) instead of trusting one.
why: The previous version blamed a stale audit UI found through .dd/ui.json, which no longer exists: the bridge now answers only through a resident of the same build and sends its data_dir. The resident uses that data_dir only when it first opens the project, so a project used from two harnesses records everything in one directory and the other looks empty.
trigger_variants: La telemetria de DD esta vacia
Count retrieval events for a project

revisit_when.description: The resident opens a store per data directory or reports which one it uses

evidence_refs.summary: hookProject returns the known project by repo-root key; body.data_dir is used only in openProject for a project not yet open.
callRunningStore posts payload, repo_root and data_dir (projectDataDir of the hook process) to the resident.
